claims.text: The WTaTiVZr alloy is a single-phase disordered BCC material.
Random distribution of W, Ta, Ti, V, and Zr produces significant lattice distortion and a broad range of local atomic misfits and stress fields.
The WTaTiVZr HEA has enhanced high-temperature plasticity and toughness relative to pure tungsten.
Severe lattice distortion in the HEA activates additional slip systems at elevated temperature.
Severe lattice distortion enhances dynamic recovery through dislocation climb and/or cross-slip at elevated temperature.
Activation of additional slip systems and enhanced dynamic recovery produce improved plastic flow and toughness.
Pure tungsten has fewer active slip systems than the HEA under the specified conditions.
Dynamic recovery is less active in pure tungsten than in the HEA under the same conditions.
At temperatures of at least approximately 1200°C, the HEA will have lower yield stress than pure tungsten under identical loading conditions.
At temperatures of at least approximately 1200°C, the HEA will sustain greater plastic strain before failure than pure tungsten.
At temperatures of at least approximately 1200°C, the HEA will exhibit greater toughness than pure tungsten.
In-situ characterization will show greater dislocation mobility in the HEA than in pure tungsten.
In-situ characterization will show dynamic recovery in the HEA that is absent or less pronounced in pure tungsten.
The proposed mechanism applies only while the HEA remains single-phase and disordered and the temperature is high enough to activate recovery.
Composition changes, second phases, or temperatures substantially outside the high-temperature regime may place the material outside the prediction's scope.
Testing the HEA and pure tungsten under identical temperature, strain-rate, loading, and environmental conditions provides the proposed controlled comparison.

Failure to observe statistically significant improvements in plastic strain, elongation, and toughness together with failure to observe enhanced dislocation activity or recovery would falsify lattice distortion as the primary cause.
